arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'daphne/ws_protocol.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('daphne.ws_protocol')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import time
from unittest import mock
from daphne.ws_protocol import WebSocketProtocol
p = WebSocketProtocol.__new__(WebSocketProtocol)
p.state = WebSocketProtocol.STATE_CONNECTING
p.server = mock.Mock()
p.server.websocket_connect_timeout = 10
p.server.websocket_timeout = 10
p.duration = mock.Mock(return_value=100)
with mock.patch.object(WebSocketProtocol, 'serverReject') as rej, mock.patch.object(WebSocketProtocol, 'serverClose') as clo:
    p.check_timeouts()
    print('rejected', rej.called, 'closed', clo.called)
    assert rej.called, 'stale connecting socket must be rejected on timeout release'
print('ws_timeout_ok')
